notes: Physics is deterministic on this host; the seed list is recorded for provenance and for the declared evaluation set.
Thresholds are fixed before the runs and are not adjusted afterwards.
Camera frames are renders of the true scene; control and predicates use ground-truth state (marked in the report).
The 10-run set is the fixed scene set; a randomized scene set may be reported separately and is not part of the >=8/10 target.
